methods.name: Multi-query Web Search
methods.description: Generates 3-5 variant search queries from the input, searches DuckDuckGo HTML for each, parses and deduplicates results by URL.

methods.name: Wikipedia API Deep Extraction
methods.description: Uses Wikipedia API to search articles, extract summaries, sections, references, and categories. Follows 'See also' links for breadth.

methods.name: arXiv Academic Paper Search
methods.description: Uses arXiv API to find academic papers, extracts titles, authors, abstracts, categories, and dates.

methods.name: Hybrid Multi-Source Aggregation v2
methods.description: Combines all 5 methods (web search, Wikipedia, arXiv, OpenAlex, Wikidata) into a parallel pipeline. Cross-references findings, applies credibility tiers, corroboration scoring, and TF-IDF deduplication.

methods.name: Iterative Deepening Search
methods.description: Does 3 rounds of progressively deeper DuckDuckGo searching. Each round analyzes results to generate focused follow-up queries.

methods.name: OpenAlex Academic Search
methods.description: Uses the OpenAlex API to search 250M+ academic works. Extracts titles, authors, publication year, abstract (reconstructed from inverted index), citation count, DOI, and open access URL. Sorted by citation count.

methods.name: Wikidata Knowledge Extraction
methods.description: Queries Wikidata search API to find structured knowledge about a topic. Extracts entity labels, descriptions, aliases, sitelinks, and related properties.

utilities.name: Deduplication Utilities
utilities.description: TF-IDF-based similarity scoring, deduplication, and source merging. Importable by all methods.

utilities.name: Benchmark Runner
utilities.description: Runs all methods against a test query and collects performance metrics.
